summary: Piotr Balcerowicz specializes in Indology and philosophy. He studied at Banaras Hindu University, the University of Warsaw, the University of Hamburg, and the Polish Academy of Sciences. He held professorships at the University of Warsaw and SWPS University.

Piotr Klafkowski is a Tibetologist who earned his PhD at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań under doctoral supervisor Jerzy Bańczerowski. He also studied under Lozang Jamspal, Geshe Geleg Gyatso, Jampa Kelzang Rinpoche, and Nyalo Tulku Jampa Kelsang Rinpoche.

Poerbatjaraka worked in Indology and linguistics, completing his doctorate at Leiden University under Nicolaas Johannes Krom. He was a professor at Gadjah Mada University, the University of Indonesia, and Udayana University, which he also founded.

Polly Young-Eisendrath is a scholar of religious studies and Buddhist studies. She studied Zen under Philip Kapleau, attended Ohio University, Goddard College, and Washington University in St. Louis, and became clinical associate professor in psychiatry at the University of Vermont in 1994.
Pori Park works in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She studied under Robert E. Buswell Jr. and served as an assistant professor of religious studies at Arizona State University.
Poulami Ray is a historian and archaeologist who studied under doctoral supervisor Ranjit Sen. She is attested as a research scholar/fellow at the Asiatic Society in 2026.
Prabal Kumar Sen is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. He held posts at the Ramakrishna Mission Institute of Culture and the University of Calcutta, where he was attested as professor in 2009.

Prabodh Chandra Bagchi studied Indology, Buddhist studies, and sinology at Krishnagar Government College, the University of Calcutta, and the University of Paris under Sylvain Lévi. He held posts at the University of Calcutta, Visva-Bharati University, and Peking University.

Prafulla Chandra Ray worked in Indology and history/archaeology. He studied at Vidyasagar College, Presidency College, the University of Calcutta, and the University of Edinburgh. He held posts at Presidency College, the University College of Science, and the University of Calcutta.
Pragati Sahni works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. She studied under Damien Keown and is attested as an associate professor at the University of Delhi in 2026.
Praggnaparamita Biswas is a scholar of Indology who studied under doctoral supervisor Ratna Basu. She is attested as a research scholar/fellow at the Asiatic Society in 2026.

Prahlad Pradhan worked in Indology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Patna University and Visva-Bharati University. His posts included research fellow at Visva-Bharati, principal at Gangadhar Meher University, and professor at Utkal University (~1963–1975).

Pramod Chandra specialized in history/archaeology and Indology. He studied at Elphinstone College, Georgetown University, and the University of Mumbai. He served as professor at the University of Chicago (1971–1980) and Harvard University (1980–2004).

Prasanna Venkatesh T. S. works in computational fields and Indology. He has held posts at the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad, and Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College as a Ph.D. research scholar.
Prasarn Lao-areun is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied under Viroj Inthanon and earned a PhD from the University of Mysore (attested 2014).

Pratap Chandra Chunder was a scholar in history/archaeology and Indology. He studied at Hindu School, Presidency College, Kolkata, and the University of Calcutta, where he studied under Prabodh Chandra Bagchi from ~1938 to 1941.
Pratap Kumar Penumala is a scholar of religious studies and Indology. He served as a professor at the University of KwaZulu-Natal and as a visiting professor at Colorado College (both attested 2010).

Pratapaditya Pal works in history/archaeology, Indology, and Tibetology. He studied at the University of Calcutta and the University of Cambridge, holding curatorial posts at the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, and the Los Angeles County Museum of Art.

Prayoon Mererk is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He served as rector of Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University (attested 2010–2011) and chairperson of the International Council for the Day of Vesak (attested 2010).

id: P:Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark
summary: Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark was a scholar in Tibetology and history/archaeology. He studied at Lycée Janson-de-Sailly and the London School of Economics, later serving in the Office of Strategic Services from ~1942 to 1945.
